Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Missed discovery — propose a quick technical deep-dive

Hi Tom —

Sorry we missed you on today's discovery call. Appreciate the time you did spend with our SDR earlier — looks like there's momentum and a few engineering questions that are best addressed in a short technical deep-dive. Quick recap from our notes:
- Primary use case: patient-facing triage and summarization of unstructured intake forms
- Key constraints: PHI handling, on-prem deployment for some sites, 50ms median token latency target
- Success metric: 30% reduction in manual triage time in pilot

Would you be available for a focused 30-minute technical deep-dive next week with our infra lead and a solutions engineer? I can carve two tight windows so we don't keep this open-ended:

Option A: Tue Jun 15, 10:00–10:30 PDT
Option B: Thu Jun 17, 15:30–16:00 PDT

If neither works, tell me the single best 30-minute block and I will lock it. We have limited engineering capacity next week, so I need to hold slots for 24 hours before releasing.

Attached: high-level deep-dive agenda (one pager).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182
